machine-chest-press.criteria: Seated lever chest press, back supported, feet planted, handles near chest; press forward with control and return.

machine-shoulder-press.criteria: Seated lever shoulder press, back supported and feet planted; press overhead without locked elbows or trunk sway.

pec-deck.criteria: Seated bent-elbow pec deck, forearms supported on vertical pads; maintain elbow angle and bring arms together in front of chest.

limits: Procedural shared human, newly constructed seated machine and exercise-specific motion. Simplified linkage; reference technique rather than a particular commercial machine. Sampled support and kinematics, not full mesh collision or biomechanical certification. Local only; production and phone pending.
